sloka: ततो गदां समाविध्य माणिभद्रेण राक्षसः ।धूम्राक्षस्ताडितो मूर्ध्नि विह्वलः स पपात ह ।। ७.१५.११ ॥
transliteration: tato gadāṁ samāvidhya māṇibhadreṇa rākṣasaḥ ।dhūmrākṣastāḍito mūrdhni vihvalaḥ sa papāta ha ।। 7.15.11 ॥

translations.english: Then, Maṇibhadra, having brandished his mace, struck the Rakshasa Dhūmrākṣa on the head, and he, bewildered, indeed fell.
